prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn retry_plan(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse comma-separated canonical three-digit ASCII HTTP status codes in 100..599. Stop successfully at the first 2xx and return the zero-based indices of earlier retryable statuses joined by commas. Retryable statuses are 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504. A different status before success returns fatal@index. If all are retryable, return their indices.
Visible example: 503,429,200,500 returns 0,1; 503,404 returns fatal@1.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: pub fn retry_plan(input:&str)->Option<String>{let mut o=vec![];for(i,x)in input.split(',').enumerate(){if x.len()!=3||!x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit())||x.as_bytes()[0]<b'1'||x.as_bytes()[0]>b'5'{return None}let c:i32=x.parse().ok()?;if(200..=299).contains(&c){return Some(o.join(","))}if[408,429,500,502,503,504].contains(&c){o.push(i.to_string())}else{return Some(format!("fatal@{}",i))}}Some(o.join(","))}
